name: AGT Food and Ingredients Inc.
summary: AGT Food and Ingredients Inc. operates as a processor, manufacturer, and supplier of plant-based ingredients, pulses, grains, and staple foods, offering value-added food products and ingredients for retail and food industry customers. The company provides plant-based ingredients such as flours, proteins, fibres, starches, and deflavoured flours, which can be sold individually or blended for specific food applications. It offers extruded products including texturized plant protein, gluten-free pasta, and plant-based meal kits under various brands, and supplies cleaned and packaged pulses, grains, specialty crops, cereals, canned pulses, rice, milled wheat, bulgur wheat, and international food…
